# enforcement

```go
import "github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/internal/enforcement"
```

Package enforcement defines the portable, deterministic policy contract used by tool\-specific supervision adapters. It decides state transitions only; it never executes acceptance checks or handles provider credentials.

<a name="Action"></a>
## type [Action](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L36>)

Action is an observation submitted to the evaluator by an adapter.

```go
type Action string
```

<a name="ActionProgress"></a>Action values are the complete adapter event vocabulary.

```go

    ActionProgress         Action = "PROGRESS"
    ActionNoProgress       Action = "NO_PROGRESS"
    ActionWaitExternal     Action = "WAIT_EXTERNAL"
    ActionRecheck          Action = "RECHECK"
    ActionRequestVerify    Action = "REQUEST_VERIFY"
    ActionVerify           Action = "VERIFY"
    ActionRetryableFailure Action = "RETRYABLE_FAILURE"
    ActionTerminalFailure  Action = "TERMINAL_FAILURE"
)
```

<a name="Decision"></a>
## type [Decision](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L161-L168>)

Decision is the only evaluator output. Reason is a finite code and never contains source JSON, provider output, environment values, or credentials.

```go
type Decision struct {
    SchemaVersion   int         `json:"schema_version"`
    State           State       `json:"state"`
    RetryCount      int         `json:"retry_count"`
    NoProgressCount int         `json:"no_progress_count"`
    Wait            *WaitWindow `json:"wait,omitempty"`
    Reason          ReasonCode  `json:"reason"`
}
```

<a name="Evaluate"></a>
### func [Evaluate](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L203>)

```go
func Evaluate(request Request) Decision
```

Evaluate applies exactly one deterministic transition. It does not read the clock, filesystem, network, process environment, or provider output.

<a name="EvaluateJSON"></a>
### func [EvaluateJSON](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L185>)

```go
func EvaluateJSON(data []byte) Decision
```

EvaluateJSON strictly decodes and evaluates a request. Malformed JSON, unknown fields, trailing values, and invalid semantics all fail closed.

<a name="Event"></a>
## type [Event](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L145-L150>)

Event is one normalized observation. Now is required only for wait/recheck actions; Results is required only for verification.

```go
type Event struct {
    Action  Action                     `json:"action"`
    Now     string                     `json:"now,omitempty"`
    Wait    *WaitWindow                `json:"wait,omitempty"`
    Results map[string]PredicateResult `json:"results,omitempty"`
}
```

<a name="Policy"></a>
## type [Policy](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L112-L118>)

<a name="Predicate"></a>
## type [Predicate](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L106-L109>)

Predicate is one required acceptance observation. Every predicate in a policy must be observed and satisfied before the evaluator returns COMPLETE.

```go
type Predicate struct {
    ID   string        `json:"id"`
    Kind PredicateKind `json:"kind"`
}
```

<a name="PredicateKind"></a>
## type [PredicateKind](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L52>)

PredicateKind says what an adapter must observe. The evaluator consumes only the normalized observed/satisfied result and therefore remains deterministic.

```go
type PredicateKind string
```

<a name="PredicateCommandExitZero"></a>PredicateKind values are the supported normalized acceptance observations.

```go
const (
    PredicateCommandExitZero PredicateKind = "command_exit_zero"
    PredicateFileExists      PredicateKind = "file_exists"
    PredicateChecksGreen     PredicateKind = "checks_green"
    PredicateReviewApproved  PredicateKind = "review_approved"
    PredicateExactArtifact   PredicateKind = "exact_artifact_match"
)
```

<a name="PredicateResult"></a>
## type [PredicateResult](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L138-L141>)

PredicateResult is deliberately free of diagnostic strings. Adapters retain provider output separately and submit only the normalized result here.

```go
type PredicateResult struct {
    Observed  bool `json:"observed"`
    Satisfied bool `json:"satisfied"`
}
```

<a name="ReasonMalformedInput"></a>ReasonCode values are the complete non\-secret decision explanation vocabulary.

    ReasonRetryExhausted        ReasonCode = "RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED"
    ReasonWaitingExternal       ReasonCode = "WAITING_EXTERNAL"
    ReasonWaitNotDue            ReasonCode = "WAIT_NOT_DUE"
    ReasonWaitRecheckDue        ReasonCode = "WAIT_RECHECK_DUE"
    ReasonWaitDeadlineExceeded  ReasonCode = "WAIT_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED"
    ReasonVerificationRequested ReasonCode = "VERIFICATION_REQUESTED"
    ReasonAcceptancePassed      ReasonCode = "ACCEPTANCE_PASSED"
    ReasonAcceptanceFailed      ReasonCode = "ACCEPTANCE_FAILED"
    ReasonTerminalFailure       ReasonCode = "TERMINAL_FAILURE"
    ReasonTerminalState         ReasonCode = "TERMINAL_STATE"

<a name="WaitOwner"></a>
## type [WaitOwner](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L65>)

WaitOwner is the accountable system or actor for an external wait. It is a finite code so a decision never reflects an arbitrary owner string.

```go
type WaitOwner string
```

<a name="WaitOwnerOperator"></a>WaitOwner values are the supported accountable external owners.

```go
const (
    WaitOwnerOperator         WaitOwner = "operator"
    WaitOwnerGitHub           WaitOwner = "github"
    WaitOwnerGitea            WaitOwner = "gitea"
    WaitOwnerClaude           WaitOwner = "claude"
    WaitOwnerCodex            WaitOwner = "codex"
    WaitOwnerOpenCode         WaitOwner = "opencode"
    WaitOwnerRadioactiveRalph WaitOwner = "radioactive-ralph"
    WaitOwnerCodeRabbit       WaitOwner = "coderabbit"
    WaitOwnerAIGitBot         WaitOwner = "ai-git-bot"
    WaitOwnerExternal         WaitOwner = "external"
)
```

<a name="WaitWindow"></a>
## type [WaitWindow](<https://github.com/jbcom/radioactive-ralph/blob/main/internal/enforcement/policy.go#L122-L126>)

WaitWindow records who owns an external wait and exactly when it must be reconsidered. Times are RFC 3339 strings so JSON adapters preserve them.

```go
type WaitWindow struct {
    Owner     WaitOwner `json:"owner"`
    RecheckAt string    `json:"recheck_at"`
    Deadline  string    `json:"deadline"`
}
```
